request:
Source ticket: MAG-14 — https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-14/startend-battery-percentage

Please create the columns `start_battery_pct and end_battery_pct on the database table supercharger_sessions.`

Check if there is a way to know what's the start/end battery percentage . *Base on the API response* when fetching supercharger sessions data. Maybe based on the energy added? 

grill me about that

tasks.title: Goose migration adding the five columns to supercharger_sessions
Add five pointer fields to the SuperchargerSession struct
query.sql header comment documenting the R3/R8 upsert exclusion
DB-integration tests T6.1-T6.4 incl. the R3/R8 upsert regressions

decisions.decision: Database design gate CONFIRMED — five nullable columns, all omitted from UpsertSuperchargerSession, no new index
decisions.why: Design, rationale and index plan were presented and iterated once (the _est snapshot pair was added at the user's request) before confirmation.

decisions.decision: Accepted the worker's unrequested proposal.md edit for internal coherence
decisions.why: Its 'three columns' language would have contradicted design.md after the revision. Mechanical, renegotiates nothing approved.

events.event: Dispatched telemetry worker (sonnet) to author artifacts. Artifacts-only scope — no implementation.

Design gate presented to user. Result: confirmed with one revision — add start/end_battery_pct_est as a frozen verification snapshot (roadmap R8). Worker re-dispatched via SendMessage to reuse context.

Artifacts revised and re-validated (openspec validate --strict: valid). CONTRACT NOTE: README.md was modified outside the worker's sandbox and not reported; excluded from this change's commits and left in the working tree for the user to triage.
